name: Expose State Threats
description: State threats include the use of spies to influence others. Cyber operations can expose the threat from this activity to prevent it happening again.

name: Counter Disinformation
description: Countering disinformation efforts by rogue actors allows for the truth to be understood, and for people to make their own informed decisions.

name: Protect Military Operations
description: A nation’s military carries some of the most sensitive and dangerous technologies. Protecting these from threats through cyber operations will ensure they remain effective.

name: Disrupt a Terrorist Group
description: Terrorist groups represent a serious threat to security. Disrupting these groups makes the nation safer and more secure.

name: Disrupt State Threats
description: Rogue or malign states seek to do damage to others. Through cyber means, they can be constrained and deterred from their activities.

name: Influence Behaviours of Hostile Actors
description: Hostile actors can be persuaded to take other actions or change their plans as a result of cyber influence.

name: Prevent Cyber Attacks
description: Nations, criminals, and hacktivists carry out attacks on innocent victims. Preventing these makes the world more secure.

name: Disrupt Online Criminals
description: Stopping online criminals from carrying out their operations means innocent people can use the internet safely.

name: Expose Illegal Activity
description: Exposing the activities of criminals, either publicly or privately, reduces the likelihood of them carrying out illegal actions: in the future.

name: Counter Hostle Malware
description: Uncontrolled malware is used across the world to do damage. Cyber operations can control the spread of malware and protect people.

name: Support Law Enforcement
description: Cyber operations can be used to track down criminals, expose their activities and protect innocent people.

name: Support to Military Operations
description: Cyber operations can support and protect military operations to help them safely meet their mission objectives, giving military commanders a wider set of options for force protection.
